latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the cloud-architect skill.

- Provides expert guidance for designing and optimizing cloud architectures across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Supports planning migrations, multi-cloud deployments, cost optimization, disaster recovery, and security architecture.
- Follows Well-Architected Framework principles and enforces security, availability, and cost governance best practices.
- Includes workflow steps (discovery, design, security, cost, migration, operate) and clear must/must-not design constraints.
- Outputs architecture diagrams, rationale, security design, cost strategies, and deployment approaches.
